narr: Low pressure was slowly moving northeast from IN through northern OH during the day of July 11th, 2021, lifting a warm front northward towards northwest PA. Showers and thunderstorms moved northeast across Erie County, PA for much of the daytime hours ahead of this front. An low echo centroid storm with intense rainfall rates around 1.5 per hour produce efficient heavy rainfall over an area with saturated soils from the showers during the morning and afternoon hours. PWAT values were near 1.8, with modest MUCAPE values generally 500 j/kg or less. This intense burst of rain dropped around 1.5 in a little over an hour in the Edinboro area.
ev: Emergency management reported several road closures in and around Edinboro due to flooding. Reports of numerous flooded basements. Received video of a creek out of it's banks, with several inches of water flowing over Gibson Hill Road near Capp Road.
